Resampling was performed on the existing SNF affinity subgraph; modality affinities and SNF were not re-estimated.

reports.statistical_interpretation: Overlap between the partition and TCGA stage/grade labels is very low, with ARI near zero for both labels.
reports.medical_interpretation: The partition does not echo TCGA stage or grade labels. Low overlap does not by itself establish molecular novelty; published molecular subtype taxonomies were not evaluated.
limitations: Only TCGA stage and grade labels are assessable.
Published molecular ccRCC subtype taxonomies were not evaluated.
